mechanism.claim: The completed third UTC hourly BTC return predicts the nineteenth UTC hourly return with the opposite sign. When strictly prior BTC variation and the predictor-hour magnitude are elevated, fade the third-hour return only during the later published target hour.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of the completed 02:00-03:00 UTC BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTOCM uses the first UTC half-hour to trade the final half-hour with momentum. HVIHR instead freezes a separately published hourly reversal pair, 02:00-03:00 to 18:00-19:00 UTC, with a fifteen-hour information gap. It uses no flow, volume, funding, OI, price-level anchor, fitted coefficient, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the twenty-four hours ending at 03:00 UTC must rank in its causal upper 35%, and the completed predictor hour must be in its own upper 30% magnitude tail
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one sparse 18:05 UTC position per day, lasting only to 19:00 UTC, is absent from Gross9 clocks

features.decision_grid: every calendar day; predictor feature completes at exact 03:00 UTC and the frozen execution decision is 18:00 UTC
features.predictor_hour: 60 exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [02:00,03:00) UTC
features.predictor_return: log(02:59 close/02:00 open), finite and strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 180 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 120, current excluded
features.source_validity: exact distinct minute grids, finite positive coherent OHLC, no imputation

clock.feature_available: 03:00 UTC after the completed predictor hour and variation window
clock.decision: 18:00 UTC fixed target-hour boundary; no intervening data enter the signal
clock.hold: 55 elapsed minutes inside the published nineteenth UTC hour
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: the strongest-magnitude reversal coefficient reported in the paper's seven-pair Bitcoin Table 2

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no hour pair, rank history, predictor strength, variation, side, entry, exit, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.paper: Intraday return predictability in the cryptocurrency markets: Momentum, reversal, or both
external_basis.journal: The North American Journal of Economics and Finance 62 (2022) 101733
external_basis.reported_relation: Table 2 reports r3 predicting r19 with coefficient -0.16 and Newey-West t=-3.50 in Bitcoin hourly data.
external_basis.hour_mapping: r3 is 02:00-03:00 UTC and r19 is 18:00-19:00 UTC under the paper's p0=00:00 hourly indexing.
external_basis.untested_adaptation: the causal high-variation and predictor-magnitude gates, Binance perpetual execution, 18:05 entry, and current sample are not a published replication
